catalog.name: Blue Mango
catalog.summary: DTF Genetics flagship selection line built around vigorous growth, branching, resin production, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.
catalog.selectionNotes: Use the profile as breeding documentation rather than a phenotype guarantee. Individual expression and finish time vary with phenotype and environment.
catalog.imageAlt: Blue Mango Regular F2 strain card

catalog.name: Blue Mango
catalog.summary: Feminized F2 expression of the Blue Mango breeding project, preserving the same documented lineage while providing a female-seed route for the current release.
catalog.selectionNotes: Generation, seed type, phenotype, and environment all influence expression. Transaction details remain controlled by the live product listing.
catalog.imageAlt: Blue Mango Feminized F2 strain card

catalog.name: Blue Bubblegum
catalog.summary: Sweet fruit-and-bubblegum breeding direction built from Bubblegum Kush and Blueberry Butcher and documented as a parent line in the Mango Bubbles project.
catalog.selectionNotes: The profile describes the breeding direction and known lineage; it does not promise a fixed aroma, yield, potency, or finish date.

catalog.name: Mango Bubbles
catalog.summary: A DTF Genetics breeding project combining the fruit-forward direction of Blue Mango with the sweet bubblegum influence of Blue Bubblegum.
catalog.selectionNotes: This is a breeding-library profile, not a statement of current retail availability.

catalog.name: Blueberry Butcher
catalog.summary: An important DTF parent line documented in the ancestry of both Blue Mango and Blue Bubblegum.
catalog.selectionNotes: Parent-line documentation does not imply that seed packs are currently offered for sale.

catalog.name: Dream Berry
catalog.summary: Fruit-forward hybrid project tracked in the DTF breeding library for aroma selection, bag appeal, and practical home-grow evaluation.
catalog.selectionNotes: This profile documents the project and lineage without implying current retail availability.

catalog.name: Sweet Dream
catalog.summary: A breeding concept combining familiar Blue Dream structure with a sweeter modern hybrid direction.
catalog.selectionNotes: This profile documents the breeding project and does not imply current retail availability.

catalog.name: Hawaiian Blue Dream
